sections.title: Portugal Uncorked: Art, Culture & Culinary Journey
sections.subtitle: Introduction
sections.html:
Portugal Uncorked: Art, Culture & Culinary Journey

Experience Portugal’s vibrant cities and rich heritage on a journey through Lisbon, Sintra, Tomar, Óbidos, Conímbriga, and Porto. Discover historic monuments, contemporary art, medieval towns, Roman ruins, and local wine traditions, culminating in immersive workshops and culinary delights across this captivating country.

sections.title: Day 1 - Welcome to Lisbon
sections.html:
Arrive in Lisbon

Arrive in Portugal’s lively capital and settle in. Meet your English-speaking tour conductor and fellow travelers at an informal welcome gathering. Enjoy the evening at leisure in Lisbon.

sections.title: Day 2 - Lisbon: Monuments and Contemporary Art
sections.html:
Guided Panoramic City Tour of Lisbon

Explore Lisbon on a guided panoramic city tour. Discover the historic Belém district and visit the magnificent Jerónimos Monastery, celebrated for its distinctive Manueline architecture.

Visit to Banksy Museum

In the afternoon, visit the Banksy Museum for a contrasting look at contemporary street art.

sections.title: Day 3 - Portuguese Tiles and Wine Traditions
sections.html:
Visit to National Tile Museum

Visit the National Tile Museum, housed in the former Madre de Deus convent, and trace the history of Portugal’s celebrated azulejo tiles from the 15th century onward.

Wine Estate Visit and Tasting

Travel to a wine estate outside Lisbon for a guided visit and tasting of regional wines accompanied by savory snacks.

sections.title: Day 4 - Sintra’s Palaces and Historic Tomar
sections.html:
Visit Pena Palace and Gardens in Sintra

Travel to enchanting Sintra to explore the colorful Pena Palace and its gardens.

Explore Quinta da Regaleira

Visit the mysterious Quinta da Regaleira, renowned for its symbolic architecture and landscaped grounds.

Orientation Walk in Tomar

Continue to Tomar for an orientation walk through its historic center, with the Convent of Christ and old synagogue considered as time permits.

sections.title: Day 5 - Medieval Óbidos and a Vineyard Visit
sections.html:
Discover Óbidos

Discover Óbidos, a beautifully preserved medieval town with cobbled lanes, whitewashed houses, and picturesque walls.

Free Time for Lunch and Exploration in Óbidos

Enjoy free time for lunch and exploration in Óbidos.

Visit a Local Wine Estate for Tasting

Visit a local wine estate for a tasting paired with tapas.

Return to Tomar for the Evening

Return to Tomar for the evening.

sections.title: Day 6 - Roman Heritage and Porto
sections.html:
Visit Conimbriga Archaeological Site and Museum

Journey north, stopping at the archaeological site and museum of Conímbriga to discover Portugal’s Roman past.

Guided Introduction to Porto

Continue to Porto, where a guided afternoon introduction reveals the city’s historic streets, distinctive architecture, and riverside atmosphere.

sections.title: Day 7 - Porto and the Douro River
sections.html:
Guided Morning Tour of Porto

Continue discovering Porto on a guided morning tour.

Douro River Cruise on Rabelo-Style Boat

Board a traditional rabelo-style boat for a scenic cruise along the Douro River, admiring Porto’s waterfront and famous bridges.

Free Time to Explore Porto

Enjoy free time to explore at your own pace.

sections.title: Day 8 - Return to Lisbon and Cork Craft Workshop
sections.html:
Travel back to Lisbon

Travel back to Lisbon.

Portuguese Cork Workshop

Take part in a hands-on Portuguese cork workshop. Learn about this distinctive local material and create two small items to bring home as personal souvenirs.

sections.title: Day 9 - Lisbon Street Art and Farewell Dinner
sections.html:
Guided Street-Art Walking Tour with Tuk-Tuk

Explore Lisbon’s vibrant urban art scene on a guided street-art walking tour, with tuk-tuk transportation arranged for the outing.

Afternoon at Leisure

Spend the afternoon at leisure before gathering for a special farewell dinner featuring Portuguese flavors.

Farewell Dinner

Gather for a special farewell dinner featuring Portuguese flavors.

sections.title: Day 10 - Departure
sections.html:
Breakfast

Enjoy breakfast and conclude your Portuguese journey.

Departure

Make your own way to the airport for your onward flight.
